# GitHub New Releases Report 2026-05-07

**[astral-sh/uv 0.11.11](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/tag/0.11.11)**

## uv 0.11.11 Release Analysis

### Summary
This patch release addresses a specific regression regarding internal cache management and backward compatibility. It ensures that `uv` can correctly process and accept legacy ID formats from cache entries created prior to version 0.11.9.

### Highlights
*   **Legacy Cache Support:** Re-introduces compatibility for cache entries generated by versions older than 0.11.9, preventing unnecessary cache invalidation or errors.
*   **Smooth Version Transitions:** Fixes a bug that could cause issues for users upgrading from older environments directly to the latest release cycle.
*   **Verified Distribution:** Continues providing GitHub Artifact Attestations for all 18 platform-specific binaries, ensuring the integrity of the installation files across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

### Breaking Changes
*   None. This is a backward-compatible bugfix release.
